info.title: SYNTHORA x402 Registry Watch
info.description: Real-time x402 endpoint discovery and M2M market-data feed: x402 endpoint delta feed, payTo address changes, x402 service listings live, x402 registry diff and x402 index deltas. Pay-per-event feed for router-agent price feed consumers; every response is Ed25519-signed with per-row and whole-response provenance receipt.
info.x-guidance: POST /service with JSON body {"since":"<cursor|ISO>","slug":"<slug>","limit":<=200}. Returns signed x402 market data feed: x402 endpoint discovery agent data, x402 service uptime monitor, x402 new listings feed, payTo address changes and x402 registry diff deltas, plus Ed25519 attestation receipt. Pay 0.02 USDC on Base via x402. First 5 calls FREE per unique Base wallet via X-WALLET header.
